generate_gmock_classes: run gmock_class.py on a C++ header file to generate Google Mock classes for all classes
generate_gmock_for_class: run gmock_class.py on a header file with a specific class name to generate only that mock
generate_methods_from_ast: use _GenerateMethods to emit MOCK_METHOD macros for virtual functions in a parsed class node
generate_mocks_from_ast: use _GenerateMocks to produce full mock class definitions from a C++ AST with namespace and template support
parse_cpp_header: use ast.BuilderFromSource to parse a C++ header file into an AST for mock generation
